notes: Execution-state and domain-planning milestone: AIDao now generates substantially richer anime/media requirements and implementation tasks, including catalog/search, detail and episode flows, playback, watch history, favorites, provider contracts, provider failure isolation, and provider management. Implementation tasks are no longer manual checkboxes; AIDao owns their state using Planned, In Progress, Verifying, Complete, or Blocked, and task status only advances from real execution/build signals. Functional UI text now uses a more explicit readable sans-serif family while script styling is limited to branding. Android-native inset/IME handling, truthful source-generation status, safe provider boundaries, and the user-controlled update path remain preserved.
